name: Holiday Traditions Family Day at the Davenport House Museum
paras: The Davenport House Museum opens its historic house and grounds on Sunday, December 13, 2026, from 10 am to 2 pm for a Family Day about winter holiday traditions across cultures and centuries. The museum says the day is free and open to the public.

Families take self-guided house tours, hear a live read-aloud of 'Twas the Night Before Christmas and join hands-on activities for all ages. Local chefs also demonstrate holiday foods, including Gullah Geechee and Jewish heritage dishes.
tip: The house tours are self-guided, so kids can go at their own pace between the read-aloud and the activity tables.
